definitions.aggregation: Fractions normalized within each episode; 32 episodes per family, 64 per model; equal weights across models and paired seed cells. Shared tasks and sampling cells are not independent initialization seeds.
definitions.take_attempt: At least one parsed canonical action beginning with take; attempt only, not verified acquisition.
definitions.move_attempt: At least one canonical move action, including public put aliases; attempt only, not verified placement.
definitions.any_format_error: JSON/action parser failure; does not measure hidden physical action validity.
definitions.literal_no_effect_fraction: Fraction of steps with observation exactly Nothing happens. after stripping outer whitespace; observable proxy, not an oracle of invalid actions.
definitions.hit_call_limit: Episode has exactly config.max_steps actions, including any success at the cap.
definitions.exact_command_repetition_fraction: 1 - number of distinct canonical commands / step count; repeated navigation may be legitimate.
definitions.scope: Post hoc behavior description of existing outcomes; no causal attribution, inference, early stopping, or change to frozen training/evaluation.
